alt.en: A black-and-white sheet-music cover: "To John P. Ordway, Esq.", "The One Horse Open Sleigh" in tall letters, "Song and Chorus" inside ornamental scrolls, "Written & composed by J. Pierpont", the Boston publisher's line, and at the top a handwritten note, "Deposited Sept. 16. 1857".
alt.es: Portada de partitura en blanco y negro: "To John P. Ordway, Esq.", "The One Horse Open Sleigh" en letras altas, "Song and Chorus" dentro de volutas decorativas, "Written & composed by J. Pierpont", la línea del editor de Boston y, arriba, una nota manuscrita: "Deposited Sept. 16. 1857".

caption.en: The first edition of The One Horse Open Sleigh (Boston: Oliver Ditson, 1857), dedicated to the minstrel-hall owner John P. Ordway: the Library of Congress copy, marked in ink "Deposited Sept. 16. 1857".
caption.es: La primera edición de The One Horse Open Sleigh (Boston: Oliver Ditson, 1857), dedicada a John P. Ordway, dueño de una sala de minstrel shows: el ejemplar de la Library of Congress, con la nota en tinta "Deposited Sept. 16. 1857".

source: J. Pierpont, The One Horse Open Sleigh: Song and Chorus (Boston: Oliver Ditson & Co., 1857), cover
licenceEvidence: LoC item page, Rights & Access: "the Library is not aware of any U.S. copyright protection (see Title 17, U.S.C.) or any other restrictions in the Music for the Nation: American Sheet Music materials". Published Boston 1857; Pierpont died 1893.

alt.en: A black-and-white sheet-music page numbered 4, headed "Chorus", with four voice parts on four separate staves, the words "Jingle bells, Jingle bells, Jingle all the way; Oh! what joy it is to ride" printed under the first and third, above a two-staff piano part, plate number 18200 at the foot.
alt.es: Página de partitura en blanco y negro con el número 4, con el encabezado "Chorus", con cuatro voces en cuatro pentagramas separados, con la letra "Jingle bells, Jingle bells, Jingle all the way; Oh! what joy it is to ride" bajo el primero y el tercero, sobre un acompañamiento de piano en dos pentagramas, con el número de plancha 18200 al pie.

caption.en: Pierpont's 1857 chorus, a little part-song for four voices on staves of their own: "Oh! what joy it is to ride", with the second "Jingle bells" jumping higher than the first, unlike the tune sung now.
caption.es: El estribillo de Pierpont de 1857, una pequeña canción a cuatro voces, cada una en su propio pentagrama: "Oh! what joy it is to ride", con el segundo "Jingle bells" saltando más arriba que el primero, a diferencia de la melodía que se canta hoy.

source: J. Pierpont, The One Horse Open Sleigh: Song and Chorus (Boston: Oliver Ditson & Co., 1857), p. 4, chorus, plate 18200
licenceEvidence: LoC item page, Rights & Access: "the Library is not aware of any U.S. copyright protection (see Title 17, U.S.C.) or any other restrictions in the Music for the Nation: American Sheet Music materials". Published Boston 1857; Pierpont died 1893.

alt.en: A printed songbook page numbered 18, headed "Jingle, Bells.", marked Allegro, with the tune over a piano part, the first verse and then the chorus marked with an asterisk, and at the foot the note "Accompanied by jingling glasses".
alt.es: Página impresa de un cancionero con el número 18, con el encabezado "Jingle, Bells.", marcada Allegro, con la melodía sobre un acompañamiento de piano, la primera estrofa y después el estribillo marcado con un asterisco, y al pie la nota "Accompanied by jingling glasses".

caption.en: Jingle, Bells in Carmina Collegensia, a Boston book of college songs (1876): the chorus tune sung today, every "Jingle, bells!" on one repeated note, marked "Accompanied by jingling glasses".
caption.es: Jingle, Bells en Carmina Collegensia, un libro de canciones universitarias de Boston (1876): la melodía del estribillo que se canta hoy, con cada "Jingle, bells!" en una misma nota repetida, marcada "Accompanied by jingling glasses" (acompañado del tintineo de vasos).

source: Henry Randall Waite, ed., Carmina Collegensia (Boston: Oliver Ditson & Co., 1876), music section p. 18, "Jingle, Bells"
library: Scott Library, York University Libraries (digitized by the Internet Archive)
